mechanism.claim: At exact Tuesday and Friday UTC boundaries, a completed 24-hour range whose last absolute extreme is rejected through the full-range midpoint identifies a failed late auction. Follow the rejection away from that last extreme for sixteen elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: short when the last high is later than the last low and the completed close is strictly below the range midpoint; long for the symmetric late-low rejection
mechanism.why_distinct: LEMRR uses the temporal ordering of exact daily price extremes jointly with midpoint rejection. It is not trailing-return concordance, wick magnitude, Donchian reclaim, close-VWAP displacement, run persistence, funding, flow, or a fitted threshold.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: two-sided range traversal and late-boundary failure should express most strongly in volatile markets; causal RV20 q90 is only a later audit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: at most two sparse sixteen-hour UTC-boundary positions per week, conditional on a path-order rejection

features.source_valid: exact unique minute grid, coherent finite positive OHLC, strict high>low, unequal last-extreme timestamps, no imputation

rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean exact daily returns^2 over t-20 through t-1)
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear q90 over 756 strictly prior available RV20 observations
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: only after all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.decision: Tuesday and Friday 00:00 UTC after the 24-hour window completes
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition on causal RV20 q90 decisions

definitions.no_midpoint_rejection: side opposite the last extreme on every source-valid Tuesday/Friday window
definitions.close_location_only: side of close versus midpoint on every source-valid Tuesday/Friday window
definitions.close_open_fade: negative sign of completed 24-hour open-to-close return on primary clock

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no weekday, window, extreme occurrence rule, midpoint condition, side, clock, hold, RV20, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
